data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure: Airport tab, then type and select the airport, then pick the dates, then sort, with equivalent parameters; it loses a little feasibility because it doesn't mark the dates and sort as optional, and it leaves the date-picker interaction (clicking the start-date box, then the calendar cells) unspecified.
